lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: Hehehe!

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: Mwahahahahaha!

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: What do you think

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: of my ultimate villain look?
What are you talking about?
Drake doesn't reply for a while.

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: That's weird.

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: My profile picture seems to have updated just fine.

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: You can't see it?
Oh.
That's pretty cool.

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: Moron! Put a little more effort into your response!
Wow, you've really brought BlaBla to its knees!
You're seriously the greatest ultimate villain ever!

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: That'll do.

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: You're making me blush.

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: Anyway, now that I've become the ultimate villain,

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: that naturally makes you a member of the Ultimate Villain Union too.

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: From now on, we'll commit even greater evil worthy of our name. Got it?
Do I have to?

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: Did you seriously just say that?

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: Are you really that clueless?!

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: I've already climbed to the very top,

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: so it's only a matter of time before I go down in history as the greatest villain ever!

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: You should consider it an honor!

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: As a member of the Ultimate Villain Union, your name will become legendary right alongside mine!
But what about my opinion?

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: I'm off to spread a little misery.

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: You figure out what evil deed you can commit

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: to make the Villain Union stronger and even more famous!

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: I'll be asking you what you came up with next time we talk, so have an answer ready.
When will that be?

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: That's a secret!

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: Hahahahaha!

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: Tremble in fear, for you'll never know when I'll show up next!
Okay...
I'd better avoid Drake for a while.
